# discord_invite (List Resource)

Lists the invites of every channel in a server, or of one channel. Requires the Manage Server permission, or Manage Channels for one channel.

## Example Usage

```terraform
list "discord_invite" "all" {
  provider         = discord
  include_resource = true

  config {
    server_id = var.server_id
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `server_id` (String) ID of the server (guild) to list invites of.

### Optional

- `channel_id` (String) Only list the invites of this channel.
